system.description: When a hostile creature within 30 feet of you casts a Jutsu that have both the Hand Sign (HS) and Chakra Molding (CM) components, that you can see, you can spend your reaction to irradiate their chakra, before siphoning it back into yourself. As a reaction, spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, they increase the chakra cost of the jutsu they cast by +4, and you roll 1d6, recording the die result. You gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to the result.
